finding.description: Ledger id of the finding being adjudicated.

best_supported_position.description: The position the evidence supports, stated plainly. Not a vote count.

reasoning.description: Why the artifact supports that position. Cite the lines, not the consensus.

all_missed.description: What every prior stage missed on this finding, or an explicit 'nothing'.

overall.description: Disposition of the artifact as a whole, including anything no finding covers.
